findings.note: Both post-publication rollback handlers discard the retained transaction journal whenever rollback completed, even if the subsequent direct Block-Evidence write failed. `_block` converts that write failure into a return code without reporting whether Evidence became durable, so lines 3136-3137 and 3166-3167 can delete the only recovery marker while the prior success-form resolver-evidence.yaml remains live and the publication artifacts have been restored to PRE. This contradicts the stated invariant that the journal survives until the Block record is durable and leaves a silently inconsistent generation. The disclosed uncovered `_block` ArtifactPublicationFailed branch and mutation-C gap do not exercise this combined failure.
